purpose: Implement and validate a real GGML CPU custom node around the exact v47 rotated-AFF3 algebra before any performance timing or llama.cpp model-graph attachment.

frozen_external_input.role: authenticated direct-v43 layer-0 development image; trained-v44 promotion input is intentionally unavailable until v43 and v44 pass

implementation_contract.image_loading: read-only mmap with fail-closed header, bounds, padding, semantic, and SHA-256 authentication
implementation_contract.rotation: derive FP32 cosine and sine coefficients once at image load from the stored FP16 angles; never materialize a dense weight or decoded group-scale matrix
implementation_contract.decode_tasking: split the 5120 output rows into 16-row-aligned ranges across all four GGML CPU tasks; each task owns scratch and independently rotates and quantizes the one live activation to avoid an unsupported cross-task barrier
implementation_contract.eight_token_tasking: assign complete tokens round-robin across four GGML CPU tasks
implementation_contract.graph_seam: ggml_map_custom2 over an uncomputed 5120-row shape anchor and the live 6144-row activation

promotion_sequence: pass this development correctness gate on the direct-v43 image
freeze implementation and a separate performance preregistration after v43 stops owning the CPU
repeat exact artifact parity on trained-v44 output
attach the frozen node to the Qwen3.8-27B llama.cpp model graph
run whole-model free-generation, WikiText, CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, throughput, memory, and energy gates
claim_boundary: A v48 development pass can establish only authenticated GGML graph execution and exact parity with the v47 kernel on one direct-v43 layer. It cannot establish trained-v44 quality, performance, whole-model capability, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
